title: Automatic classification
description: Classify documents by title and saved body text. Locations and manual labels stay as you set them. No document content is sent to an AI service.
enable: Enable automatic classification in this workspace
ruleHelp: A document can match several categories. A rule matches when any keyword occurs in the selected field. Changes apply after saving. Up to 20 rules and 10 keywords per rule.
name: Category name
saveError: Could not save. Check that names are unique and each rule has keywords.
conflict: Settings changed in another window. Reload this page before saving again.
defaults: Default classification rules. Enable and save to apply them.
